title: New_Bark_Town
lead_summary:
New Bark Town is a small town that can be entered from Route 29 by the West and from Route 27 by the East.
Prof. Elm's lab is located in New Bark Town, and will give Chikorita, Cyndquil or Totodile to the player's choice.

items.name: HM05 Waterfall
items.location_details: Given by Prof. Elm after obtaining at least two Johto's badges.
